name: Solflare
description: Self-custody Solana wallet for holding, transferring and spending USDC.
evidenceNote: Official wallet overview lists USDC payments and wallet features.

name: Hedera
description: Public ledger with native token issuance and tools for tokenized bonds, equities and real assets.
evidenceNote: Official use case page describes native issuance and regulated asset deployments.

name: Algorand
description: Layer 1 with protocol-native asset issuance for funds, real estate, commodities and other financial assets.
evidenceNote: Official solution page names Lofty real estate and Meld Gold deployments.

name: Cardano
description: Layer 1 supporting native tokens and smart contracts for representing real-world assets.
evidenceNote: Official documentation describes tokenization and programmable transfer restrictions; proposed standards are not presented as final.

name: Tezos
description: Blockchain ecosystem supporting tokenized commodities and fund shares through Tezos and Etherlink.

sources.title: Spiko expands tokenized funds to Etherlink

evidenceNote: Official announcement describes Spiko fund shares; Tezos and its Etherlink rollup are represented together.

name: Injective
description: Financial Layer 1 with native modules for issuing, trading and managing permissioned tokenized assets.
evidenceNote: Official solution page details token issuance, transfer permissioning and market infrastructure.

name: Sei
description: Layer 1 supporting institutional tokenization, stablecoin payments and onchain settlement.
evidenceNote: Official institutional page identifies tokenization, stablecoins and real-time settlement.

name: Sonic
description: EVM network developing settlement infrastructure for tokenized assets and stablecoins.

sources.title: Sonic USSD stablecoin and tokenized Treasury infrastructure

evidenceNote: Official March 2026 announcement describes live USSD and settlement infrastructure using tokenized Treasury assets on Sonic.

name: Sui
description: Move-based Layer 1 supporting stablecoins and tokenized Treasury exposure including Ondo USDY.
evidenceNote: Official launch announcement confirms Ondo Treasury-backed USDY on Sui.

name: Mantle
description: Ethereum Layer 2 supporting tokenized financial assets, including Ondo USDY.
evidenceNote: Issuer's current product page lists Mantle as a supported deployment.

name: Linea
description: Ethereum Layer 2 providing infrastructure for tokenization, payments and onchain settlement.
evidenceNote: Official homepage specifies tokenization and payments; this is the network, not a duplicate Consensys company profile.

name: IOTA
description: Move-based distributed ledger with configurable token issuance and controls for real-world assets.
evidenceNote: Official product documentation describes regulated coin and closed-loop token controls.

name: Kaia
description: Layer 1 with native stablecoins and infrastructure for tokenized assets and Asian payment applications.
evidenceNote: Official announcement confirms native USDT and explicitly identifies RWA applications.

name: VeChain
description: Enterprise blockchain developing asset attestation and infrastructure for verified real-world asset tokens.
evidenceNote: Official roadmap describes planned RWA attestation and asset platform; description does not imply every roadmap feature is launched.

name: MultiversX
description: Layer 1 supporting an ecosystem of real-world asset tokenization applications.
evidenceNote: Official ecosystem article documents RWA projects and tokenization activity.

name: Liquid Network
description: Bitcoin sidechain supporting issued stablecoins and transfer-restricted tokenized securities.
evidenceNote: Official network developer page lists tokenized Treasury and equity assets on Liquid.

name: NEAR
description: Blockchain and intent infrastructure supporting cross-chain settlement into stablecoins.
evidenceNote: Official product page describes exact stablecoin delivery and merchant payment integration.

name: Kava
description: Layer 1 building financial infrastructure around native stablecoins and tokenized assets.

sources.title: Where Kava fits in tokenized finance

evidenceNote: Official current strategy identifies stablecoin liquidity and tokenized financial products.

name: Rootstock
description: Bitcoin sidechain hosting collateralized dollar stablecoins and related payment applications.
evidenceNote: Official ecosystem page lists Money on Chain and stablecoin applications.

name: Fuse
description: Blockchain and wallet infrastructure for stablecoin payments and branded digital money.
evidenceNote: Official product page offers branded stablecoin issuance and payment app infrastructure.

name: COTI
description: Confidential blockchain infrastructure enabling private token transfers and asset settlement.
evidenceNote: Official documentation identifies confidential tokenization and compliant private settlement.

name: Concordium
description: Layer 1 offering protocol-level stablecoins with identity verification and programmable controls.
evidenceNote: Official solution page describes native issuance, identity and settlement.

name: AnchorX
description: Issuer of AxCNH, a reserve-backed stablecoin referenced to offshore Chinese renminbi.
evidenceNote: Official issuer page documents CNH peg, reserve backing and redemption.

name: Stablecorp
description: Canadian digital-currency provider behind the reserve-backed QCAD stablecoin.
evidenceNote: Official issuer page identifies current QCAD Digital Trust structure and separates legacy tokens.

name: IDRX
description: Provider of a reserve-backed stablecoin referenced to the Indonesian rupiah.
evidenceNote: Official issuer article explains rupiah peg and direct minting; distinct from existing Rupiah Token IDRT.

name: JPYC
description: Japanese issuer providing yen-denominated stablecoin issuance and redemption.
evidenceNote: Official company announcement describes registered issuance and redemption service.

name: MoneyGram
description: Global payments network connecting USDC wallets with cash deposits, withdrawals and cross-border transfers.
evidenceNote: Official service page confirms USDC holding, transfers and cash access.

name: Bitso
description: Digital-asset and payments provider offering stablecoin orchestration and Latin American payment rails.
evidenceNote: Official product page describes stablecoin routing and transfers; Juno products not added as a duplicate profile.

name: Yellow Card
description: Stablecoin payment infrastructure connecting treasury balances with local bank and mobile-money rails.
evidenceNote: Official product page documents APIs for fiat and stablecoin settlement.

name: Transak
description: Fiat onramp and off-ramp APIs for stablecoin deposits, payouts and remittances.
evidenceNote: Official product page details virtual bank accounts and stablecoin payouts.

name: Banxa
description: Fiat-to-crypto payment infrastructure supporting stablecoin purchases and withdrawals.
evidenceNote: Official API documentation lists USDC onramp and off-ramp support.

name: Ramp Network
description: Non-custodial wallet and payment infrastructure for buying, selling and transferring stablecoins.
evidenceNote: Official site confirms USDC transfers and fiat conversion; distinct from corporate spend platform Ramp.

name: Ramp
description: Business finance platform with stablecoin accounts and international vendor payments.
evidenceNote: Official product announcement confirms holding funds and international stablecoin payments.

name: Mural Pay
description: Stablecoin accounts and APIs for business payments, payroll and cross-border transfers.

sources.title: Mural Pay global accounts and payments

evidenceNote: Official platform page documents stablecoin accounts, wallets and payment APIs.

name: Due
description: Global payment platform connecting multi-currency accounts, stablecoins and local payment rails.
evidenceNote: Official homepage identifies multi-currency accounts, stablecoins and payment coverage.

name: Copperx
description: Stablecoin checkout, invoicing, business accounts and cross-border payout infrastructure.
evidenceNote: Official product page lists stablecoin gateway, invoices and payouts; distinct from Copper custody.

name: TransFi
description: Cross-border payment APIs connecting local currencies and payment methods with stablecoin rails.
evidenceNote: Official product page documents collections, payouts and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion.

name: Dakota
description: Stablecoin infrastructure for accounts, custody, treasury operations and global business payouts.
evidenceNote: Official platform page lists stablecoin settlement, contractor payouts and treasury; card product is marked coming soon and is not claimed as live.

name: Coinflow
description: Payment infrastructure supporting stablecoin acceptance, settlement and local-currency payouts.
evidenceNote: Official documentation identifies stablecoin pay-ins and settlement options.

name: Noah
description: Payments platform supporting USDC, USDT and EURC stablecoin balances and transfers.
evidenceNote: Official help center identifies supported stablecoins.

name: Stables
description: Stablecoin payment infrastructure connecting digital dollar balances to local payments and transfers.
evidenceNote: Official homepage documents virtual accounts and fiat/stablecoin transfers.

name: Mercuryo
description: Payment infrastructure offering fiat-to-stablecoin conversion and card payouts funded with stablecoins.
evidenceNote: Official product page documents stablecoin-funded Visa and Mastercard payouts.

name: Mesh
description: Payment network connecting crypto wallets and exchanges to stablecoin or local-currency settlement.
evidenceNote: Official homepage specifies stablecoin settlement; meshconnect.com redirects to meshpay.com.

name: Oobit
description: Payments app and business tools for spending stablecoins and sending funds to bank accounts.
evidenceNote: Official product page lists USDT spending, digital dollars and stablecoin expense management.

name: Fipto
description: Business payment and treasury infrastructure connecting fiat accounts with stablecoin settlement.
evidenceNote: Official documentation describes sending, receiving, holding and converting fiat and stablecoins.

name: Request Finance
description: Business finance platform for stablecoin invoicing, payments and treasury workflows.
evidenceNote: Official product page documents USDC and USDT business payments.

name: MiniPay
description: Self-custody Celo wallet for stablecoin transfers, local payments and fiat conversion through partners.
evidenceNote: Official wallet page identifies Celo, USDC, USDT and cUSD support; minipay.xyz redirects here.

name: Band Protocol
description: Oracle network supplying tokenized asset price feeds to onchain applications.
evidenceNote: Official article describes its data engine for traditional asset prices and tokenized asset feeds.

name: Supra
description: Oracle and blockchain infrastructure providing external market data for tokenized asset applications.
evidenceNote: Official announcement identifies oracle services for a real-world asset tokenization platform.

name: Switchboard
description: Customizable oracle network delivering external data to blockchain applications.
evidenceNote: Official documentation describes customizable external data feeds; listed as general oracle infrastructure rather than an asset issuer.

name: Zengo
description: MPC wallet supporting storage, transfers and purchases of USDC and other digital assets.
evidenceNote: Official product page confirms USDC wallet functionality; no claim made about discontinued network versions.

name: LOBSTR
description: Stellar wallet supporting USDC purchases, transfers and access to issued assets.
evidenceNote: Official help center confirms USDC purchases on Stellar through its onramp integration.

name: Bitget Wallet
description: Self-custody wallet offering stablecoin transfers, swaps and USDC earning products.
evidenceNote: Official help center documents supported stablecoin wallet products; formerly BitKeep.

name: Mento
description: Multi-currency stablecoin protocol providing onchain foreign-exchange and payment infrastructure.
evidenceNote: Official site lists its live currency stablecoins, reserves and exchange infrastructure.

name: Qivalis
description: European bank consortium developing a euro stablecoin for payments and tokenized-asset settlement.
statusNote: As of October 5, 2026, Qivalis is not yet authorized as an electronic money institution and does not issue electronic money or provide payment services to the public.
evidenceNote: Official site updated October 5, 2026 states authorization is pending and it does not yet issue electronic money; described as developing, not live.

name: Morse (formerly Sling Money)
description: Payments app using onchain USDC balances for transfers, spending and currency conversion.
evidenceNote: Official current product page confirms balances remain onchain in USDC; sling.money redirects to Morse, so there is one profile.
